label: Balance flags
description: Warnings the generator puts on a card. 'Block' flags never appear on rolled cards, only on hand-edited or remixed ones.

terms.label: No counter
terms.description: Nothing in the data can satisfy any of the card's 'countered by' links.

terms.label: Unpaired strength
terms.description: A strength has no weakness paired with it.

terms.label: Too many keys for its tier
terms.description: Keys or passives exceed the tier's budget.

terms.label: Seat overloaded
terms.description: One seat has more keys than the per-seat limit.

terms.label: Idle seat
terms.description: An operating seat owns no weapon or ability.

terms.label: Cost outside tier
terms.description: The derived cost band doesn't fit the tier.

terms.label: Name too close to a real unit
terms.description: The working name matches a real unit name in the database.

terms.label: Control without escape
terms.description: A stun or attach effect with no stated way for the victim to escape.

terms.label: Off-flavour
terms.description: Uses parts the faction flavour avoids (allowed at high spice).
